title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 523 East Railroad Street in Knox, Pennsylvania, as the "Specialist Ross A. McGinnis Memorial Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 523 East Railroad Street in Knox, Pennsylvania, as the "Specialist Ross A. McGinnis Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: A law that names a post office building in Knox, Pennsylvania, after Specialist Ross A. McGinnis, a soldier.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 523 East Railroad Street in Knox, Pennsylvania, as the "Specialist Ross A. McGinnis Memorial Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, hours, fees, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on June 13, 2016.
